summary: Kanban board with drag & drop between columns, card reordering, an optional status selector and non-drag alternative controls.
whenToUse: Visual workflows with a limited number of columns and cards.
Task management when users must be able to move cards without dragging.
whenNotToUse: Very long lists or tables: prefer DataTable or a virtualized list.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Accessible name of the board region.

props.name: columns / defaultColumns
props.description: Controlled or initial columns; each column contains its own cards.

props.name: onColumnsChange
props.description: Receives the new state after a card is moved.

props.name: onCardMove
props.description: Identifies the moved card, the previous and new columns and positions.

props.name: showStatusSelect
props.description: Shows a selector to move a card directly to any column. The column a card belongs to represents its status.

props.name: renderCard
props.description: Custom card content; the move controls remain managed by the component.

props.name: className
props.description: CSS class applied to the board container.

inherits: KanbanCard includes required id and title, an optional ReactNode description and optional string[] labels. KanbanColumn includes id, title, an optional description and cards.

keyboard.keys: Invio sulla maniglia, Tab, frecce, Invio
keyboard.action: Starts dragging, picks the column and position, and drops. Esc cancels.
Triggers the action and moves the card to the indicated adjacent column; focus stays on the moved card.

accessibility: The board is a named region; each column is a section with a heading and a list of cards.
Each action has an accessible name specifying the card and the destination column.
Drag & drop via React Aria: pointer, touch and keyboard, insertion indicators and accessible announcements.
Move buttons and the optional selector are non-drag alternatives.
responsive: Columns scroll horizontally on narrow viewports; long content wraps.
customization: Use renderCard to customize the card content and className for external styling.
commonMistakes: Using unstable or duplicate ids for columns and cards.
Expecting automatic persistence: save columns in the consumer via onColumnsChange.
limits: No persistence or network handling; save the new state in the consumer.
No column reordering or virtualization. Dragging is limited to the same board.
